description.value:
As an Action, you set this trap on the ground in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. The trap is camouflaged: a creature notices it only if it has Truesight or succeeds on a DC 15 Wisdom (@skill[Perception]) check while within 10 feet of the trap.

The trap remains for 1 hour, until it triggers, or until you retrieve it (an Action; the trap is not consumed if it has not triggered). If the hour expires, the trap is ruined and cannot be retrieved.

The trap triggers when a Large or larger creature on the ground enters a 10-foot square centered on the trap. The triggering creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be @condition[incapacitated] and have its Speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. Attacks against the creature do not gain Advantage from this effect alone. The trap is consumed when it triggers, whether the save succeeds or fails.

A creature that was affected by this trap becomes accustomed to shock traps after the effect ends. Until the creature finishes a Short Rest, it is immune to Shock Traps, but not @item[Shock Trap+|RAINTDM].

Crafting this trap takes 10 minutes (Combo List rules).

Craft (10 minutes, Combo List): Tinker's Tools — Thunderbug + Trap Tool DC 12, qty 1.

description.chatFlavor: Set a camouflaged 10-foot-square hunter trap within 5 feet.
Retrieve an unused hunter trap within 5 feet.
